title: Pain And Agony
description: A modpack that is nothing but pure endless suffering
body:
This Modpack tries to make minecraft as unplayable and hard as possible and will certainly ruin your day.

The amount of rage you will feel while playing this mod is beyond **ackermanian**, each attempt will result in nothing but a burning fever in your head.

The learning curve is in **Inverse Ackermann time.** 

If you spawn in water you must make a new world.

Good Luck.
